nodes.name: Every minute
nodes.notes: Reconciliation sweep (D-033): asks the CRM to re-send webhooks it gave up on. Successful runs are not saved.

nodes.name: Redeliver (CRM)
nodes.notes: The CRM re-sends the same event to WF-01, so it takes the normal path: normalize → WF-10, whose compare-and-set claim skips anything already screened.
